description: A loop's todo list was written or closed (S75 TD5). Every `todo set` from an agent and every close by the person publishes this event with the loop's id and slug, the whole list, its counts and whether it is still active, so a live client never parses a tool result to learn the list. closedBy is empty while the list is active and one of all-done, cleared or person once it closed.
